original_card.question: Can one misleading historical-current claim or missing research cross-reference be corrected?
methods: Trace one confusing path from onboarding to its authoritative source.
Index one tightly related family of obstructions with explicit excluded and open hypotheses.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Produce evidence-backed navigation, preserve historical records and avoid a duplicate global survey.

first_step.inspect: Follow one link from the selected record to its review and compare a potentially stale historical claim.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Repair one confusing path or produce a scoped map of one related obstruction family.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Clear navigation lowers entry cost for central research; a global survey without a concrete fix is not required.
allowed_variations: One historical-current ambiguity or one bounded family index.
scope_change_triggers: Rewriting frozen scientific packages just to change their historical wording.

actual_scope: Retitle the two blocks in docs/research/current-status.md that stay headed Current reviewed status after the #1042 and #942 historical dividers, and point each record link at the checkpoint whose decimal equals the stated kappa.
scope_change_reason: The card allows one historical-current ambiguity. These are the only two blocks that still use the current heading while stating a kappa other than the live selected decimal. Later sections that are already titled superseded, and that still link the live selected record, stay unchanged.
bottleneck_link: Preserved notes send readers to current-status.md for the authoritative bound. A second heading that says current, states the #1042 or #942 kappa, and links the live #1094 record mixes the binding frontier with a historical checkpoint. This repair does not change kappa.
stop_rule: Stop once those two blocks match their checkpoint decimals and the in-memory pre-repair text fails. Do not retarget the superseded sections in this package.
evidence: scripts/research_baseline.py printed PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY at selected decimal 0.001672660197076918. verify.py prints PASS_HISTORICAL_CURRENT_STATUS_HEADINGS. The #1042 prose decimal equals certificates/checkpoints/frontier1042.json (0.001672188119205421) and the #942 prose decimal equals certificates/checkpoints/frontier942.json (0.001661960547713947). In-memory copies that restore the two Current headings, point the repaired blocks back at the live selected record, swap the two checkpoint links, or replace the #1042 prose decimal with the live decimal are rejected. make frontier1094-verify was not run. Discussion writes are not in this session's GitHub interface, so no discussion post was sent and the write was not retried.
author: Riquelme Soares (hevlyo)
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance drafted the heading repair, the checker, and these notes.
